scenes.say: In two thousand, Netflix offered to sell itself to Blockbuster. For fifty million dollars.
scenes.cap: In 2000, NETFLIX offered to sell itself to BLOCKBUSTER. For $50 MILLION.

scenes.say: Blockbuster's boss reportedly tried not to laugh.
scenes.cap: Blockbuster's boss reportedly tried not to LAUGH.

scenes.say: Blockbuster had thousands of stores. Netflix mailed DVDs in envelopes.
scenes.cap: Blockbuster had THOUSANDS of stores. Netflix mailed DVDs in ENVELOPES.

scenes.say: Then the internet got faster. And streaming came.
scenes.cap: Then the internet got faster. And STREAMING came.

scenes.say: Ten years later, Blockbuster went bankrupt.
Today, one Blockbuster store is left. In Oregon.
scenes.cap: Today, ONE Blockbuster store is left. In OREGON.

scenes.say: And Netflix? Worth hundreds of billions of dollars.
scenes.cap: And Netflix? Worth HUNDREDS OF BILLIONS.

scenes.say: All because they said no... to fifty million.
scenes.cap: All because they said NO... to $50 MILLION.

upload.title: Blockbuster Could Have Bought Netflix for $50 Million 📼 #shorts
upload.description:
In 2000, Netflix's founders offered to sell the company to Blockbuster for $50 million. Blockbuster passed. Ten years later Blockbuster was bankrupt - one store is left, in Bend, Oregon - and Netflix is worth hundreds of billions.
